t.why: A major producer of copper, gold and silver. The Chinese-built port of Chancay opened in 2024.
t.rel: It settled border disputes with Chile through an international ruling and with Ecuador through a 1998 peace deal. The Chinese-built port of Chancay opened in 2024, becoming a gateway for trade with Asia.
t.korea: Peru has a free trade agreement with Korea, and Korean companies have taken part in gas and mining projects.
t.know: Machu Picchu, built on a mountaintop by the Inca Empire in the 15th century, only became widely known to the outside world in 1911.
t.etext: It sells minerals such as copper, gold, zinc and silver, plus avocados, blueberries and fishmeal. It is a leading copper producer. Politics is unstable, but the central bank has kept inflation steady.
